newsitem.title: USA: Hartford Steam sees Dow pact cutting Q4 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Hartford Steam sees Dow pact cutting Q4 EPS.

text.p: Hartford Steam Boiler Inspection and Insurance Co said Monday fourth quarter earnings will be cut by $0.26 per share because of a loss in its joint venture with Dow Chemical Co.

Hartford Steam said it expects to report net earnings of about $0.70 per share for the quarter, from insurance, investment and engineering operations, and excluding the loss and realized capital gains.
The company said it will release 1996 earnings January 27.
Dow owns 60 percent of the venture, Radian International LLC, and Hartford Steam owns 40 percent.
Hartford Steam said it has the option to sell its interest in the venture to Dow in 1998 for $150 million.

"In view of the current business climate for environmental consulting services, the company will be evaluating its options with respect to the joint venture during the course of 1997," the company said in a release.
